title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program — Number and Combination of Programs per Customer
content:
A customer may hold up to 2 insulin pharmacy programs under the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program, and only in one combination: an Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program for the insulin their insulin pump uses, together with an Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program or Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program for their other insulins, backup pens or vials and injection supplies.

Any other customer holds one insulin pharmacy program at a time. A new insulin pharmacy program is opened only when the customer has no insulin pharmacy program of the same tier in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold status and the new program completes the one permitted combination; a closed program does not count. This is read from the customer's insulin pharmacy programs on file, by tier and status.

## Combinations

| Programs the customer would hold | Permitted? |
|---|---|
| One program on any tier | Yes |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program with Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | Yes — the permitted combination |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program with Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | Yes — the permitted combination |
| Any other pair of insulin pharmacy programs | No |
| Three or more insulin pharmacy programs | No — the limit is 2 |

## Counting

- A program counts while it is in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold; a closed program does not count.
- *Hypothetical case:* a customer whose Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program is active asks to open a second Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program. It is not opened: a program of the same tier is already held, and the pair is not the permitted combination.
- *Hypothetical case:* a customer whose earlier Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program is closed may have a new insulin pharmacy program opened; the closed program does not count.
